title: Live-In Direct Support Professional (DSP) – Henderson, NC
location: 821 Fred Royster Rd, Henderson, NC 27537, USA
description:
Experience the SYNERGY HomeCare difference, where we are united under one purpose—to bring wholehearted, life-energizing care to as many people as possible, on their own terms, in their own homes and communities.

Now, we’re proud to announce the opening of our very first group home, Alston Supportive Living in Henderson, NC! Alston Supportive Living will provide a supportive, person-centered environment for adults with intellectual and/or developmental disabilities. That starts with compassionate Direct Support Professionals (DSPs) like YOU! When you join the SYNERGY HomeCare of North Raleigh team, you’ll feel appreciated, recognized, and rewarded for the comforting, life-affirming care that comes right from your heart.

Our promise to our residents is to bring full support for fuller lives and to elevate their confidence knowing they have a caring DSP like you by their side.

Live-In Direct Support Professional (DSP) – Henderson, NC

Are you looking for a unique and rewarding opportunity to make a lasting impact in the lives of adults with disabilities? Alston Supportive Living is seeking a Live-In Direct Support Professional (DSP) to reside in our group home and provide daily support, supervision, and care to our residents.

This is a live-in position, which includes private accommodations within the group home.

Do you:
Enjoy serving others?
Have a big heart with a lot of encouragement to share?
Take charge with a warm smile and positive attitude?

We are especially seeking applicants with significant experience supporting individuals with intellectual and/or developmental disabilities. Experience is highly recommended and will be given top priority.

SYNERGY HomeCare of North Raleigh offers:
Competitive pay
Direct deposit
Paid orientation and hands-on training
Time-and-a-half pay for overtime and holidays
Flexible scheduling with scheduled days off for live-in staff
Private accommodations within the group home
Employee recognition programs
As a Live-In Direct Support Professional (DSP), you will:
Support daily living and habilitation needs:
Assist residents with activities of daily living (ADLs) and skill-building, as outlined in their Person-Centered Plans (PCP).
Encourage and support resident participation in home and community-based activities, as appropriate to their abilities and interests.
Ensure health and safety:
Supervise and monitor residents at all times to ensure their safety and well-being.
Respond appropriately to emergencies, following established procedures.
Implement individualized service plans:
Carry out interventions, training, and supports specified in each resident’s PCP, including behavior support strategies as applicable.
Document residents’ progress, incidents, and daily activities according to state and agency requirements.
Medication assistance:
Assist with self-administration of medications, after completing required training and competency checks.
Accurately record medication administration and report any concerns immediately.
Promote resident rights and dignity:
Treat all individuals with respect, protect their privacy, and uphold their rights and choices.
Maintain a safe, clean home:
Participate in routine cleaning and maintenance to ensure the living environment is safe and sanitary.
Report any maintenance or safety concerns promptly.
Participate in training and team meetings:
Attend all required training sessions (including CPR/First Aid, Medication Administration, client rights, documentation, and more).
Participate in team meetings and communicate effectively with supervisors and team members.
Transportation:
Provide transportation for residents to appointments, community outings, or other activities as required.
Requirements:
Must be at least 18 years old
High school diploma or GED required
At least one year of experience working with individuals with intellectual and/or developmental disabilities is highly recommended and will be given priority
Must pass all required background checks and drug screening
Must complete all required pre-service and annual training (including Medication Administration and CPR/First Aid)
Must have reliable transportation, a valid driver’s license, and automobile insurance

If you are ready for a meaningful live-in role and want to be part of this exciting new chapter at Alston Supportive Living in Henderson, NC, apply today and join our outstanding team at SYNERGY HomeCare of North Raleigh!

title: Floater Caregiver
description:
Job Title: Floater Caregiver

Pay Range: $17–$19/hour

Hours: 70 Guaranteed Hours per Pay Period

Locations Covered: Round Rock, TX • North Austin, TX • Cedar Park, TX

Company: Synergy HomeCare

Employment Type: Part-Time/Full-Time (Float Schedule)

 

 

About Us:

 

Synergy HomeCare is a trusted name in home-based support, offering compassionate caregiving services that promote safety, independence, and dignity. We serve families across Central Texas, providing personalized care for seniors, children, and individuals with special needs. We are currently hiring a Floater Caregiver to support clients across multiple service areas with guaranteed hours.

 

 

Position Summary:

 

As a Floater Caregiver, you will provide direct care services to clients in their homes across several assigned locations. This position is ideal for dependable, flexible caregivers who enjoy variety in their schedule and are committed to delivering high-quality, compassionate care. Guaranteed hours provide financial stability, regardless of daily schedule changes.

 

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Assist clients with activities of daily living (ADLs), including bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, and mobility support.

• Provide companionship, emotional support, and basic household assistance such as light housekeeping, meal preparation, and medication reminders.

• Travel between client homes in Round Rock, North Austin, and Cedar Park based on agency needs.

• Fill in for other caregivers as needed, often with short notice.

• Maintain accurate care logs and communicate effectively with office staff and family members.

• Follow care plans and safety protocols set by Synergy HomeCare and healthcare providers.

 

 

Requirements:

• Valid Driver’s License and reliable transportation (Required)

• Willingness to travel between service areas

• Must pass background check and drug screening

• Prior experience as a caregiver (1+ year preferred; CNA certification is a plus)

• Ability to work flexible shifts (including weekdays, weekends, or evenings as needed)

• Strong communication and time management skills

• Genuine compassion for seniors, children, and families in need of care

 

 

What We Offer:

• Guaranteed 30 hours per pay period, regardless of shift assignment

• Competitive pay: $17–$19 per hour, depending on experience

• Flexible schedule and supportive team

• Paid training and development opportunities

• Mileage reimbursement (if applicable)

• Opportunities for long-term placements

description:
About Us

At Synergy HomeCare of Ellicott City, we believe everyone deserves to live life with dignity, respect, and compassion — in the comfort of home. We are a trusted, locally owned provider of non-medical home care services for all ages including seniors, individuals with disabilities, and families who need extra support with their loved ones.

 

We are a rapidly growing company with a clear vision for the future: to expand our services, reach more families, and become the top home care provider in every community we serve. Our growth is driven by a commitment to exceptional care and a talented team that’s passionate about making a real difference. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for motivated professionals who want to grow with us — and help shape what’s next for Synergy HomeCare.

Position Summary

We are seeking a motivated, results-driven Sales Professional to join our team. This role is responsible for driving new client acquisitions, building strong referral relationships, and achieving sales targets. If you thrive in a relationship-based sales environment, enjoy helping families find care solutions, and want to be rewarded for your results — we’d love to meet you!

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute a territory sales plan to achieve aggressive growth targets for new client referrals.

Build and maintain strong, lasting relationships with referral partners, including hospitals, rehabilitation centers, physicians, social workers, senior living communities, and other community organizations.

Identify new markets and opportunities as Synergy HomeCare expands its services and geographic reach.

Conduct in-home consultations with prospective clients and families to explain services and convert leads into active clients.

Attend local networking events, health fairs, and community outreach activities to increase brand awareness and support our expansion goals.

Track sales activity and pipeline progress in CRM tools and provide regular reports to management.

Collaborate closely with the care team to ensure a seamless transition from inquiry to service start.

Consistently meet or exceed monthly and annual growth targets, contributing directly to the company’s expansion.

Qualifications

Proven track record in sales — healthcare, home care, or senior living sales experience preferred.

Strong relationship-building and networking skills.

Self-motivated and goal-oriented with the ability to work independently.

Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for local travel.

Passion for helping families navigate home care options.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation: Base salary ranging between 60k- 70k plus commission — with uncapped earning potential for top performers. Successful sales professionals have the opportunity to earn well over $100K+ per year by driving growth and new business.

Paid training and ongoing support to help you thrive in our fast-growing, dynamic environment.

Flexible work environment with local travel to develop new business in expanding service areas.

Opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of our clients and families while growing your own career.

How to Apply

If you’re driven to succeed and want to help families find quality care solutions, please send your resume and a brief cover letter explaining why you’re the perfect fit for this role to hetalshah@synergyhomecare

Synergy HomeCare of Ellicott City is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

description:

SYNERGY HomeCare of Toms River is seeking a Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) to join our growing team! Conduct comprehensive patient assessments and reassessments

Coordinate care and maintain quality standards under the supervision of the Director of Nursing

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

Competitive pay

Mileage reimbursement

401(k) retirement plan

Employee Assistance Program

Employee discount perks

If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact and join an outstanding team at SYNERGY HomeCare, apply today!

title: ¡Oportunidad de Carrera como Cuidador(a)!
description:
¡Oportunidad de Carrera como Cuidador(a)! – Haz la Diferencia con SYNERGY HomeCare

¿Te apasiona ayudar a los demás y buscas una carrera con propósito? En SYNERGY HomeCare, estamos en busca de cuidadores(as) compasivos(as), responsables y profesionales para brindar atención no médica en el hogar. Ya sea que tengas experiencia en el cuidado de personas o estés buscando iniciar una carrera gratificante, ¡nos encantaría que formes parte de nuestro equipo!

¿Te gustaría...?

Brindar apoyo y comodidad a quienes más lo necesitan.
Ser un(a) cuidador(a) con vocación de servicio y un gran corazón.
Ofrecer atención excepcional y marcar la diferencia en la vida de los demás.

Si esto te describe, ¡SYNERGY HomeCare es el lugar ideal para ti!

¿Por qué trabajar en SYNERGY HomeCare?

En SYNERGY HomeCare, creamos un ambiente de trabajo basado en la compasión y el respeto, tanto para nuestros clientes como para nuestros cuidadores. Como agencia de atención domiciliaria de propiedad y operación local, ofrecemos una amplia variedad de servicios de cuidado no médico, desde compañía hasta asistencia personal, permitiendo a nuestros clientes mantener su independencia y dignidad en casa.

¿Qué beneficios te ofrecemos?

Salario competitivo – Tu esfuerzo y dedicación serán recompensados.
Seguro médico, dental y de visión – Disponible para empleados de medio tiempo y con cobertura parcial en ciertos planes para empleados de tiempo completo.
Tiempo libre pagado (PTO) – Disponible para empleados elegibles.
Programa de pago al día siguiente – Accede a tu salario cuando lo necesites.
Horarios flexibles – Adapta tu horario a tu estilo de vida.
Asignaciones locales – Te asignamos clientes cerca de tu ubicación.
Reembolso de kilometraje – Compensación por gastos de transporte al realizar mandados para los clientes.
Capacitación continua – Cursos gratuitos y pagados para mejorar tus habilidades y avanzar en tu carrera.
Bonos por referencias – Gana recompensas por recomendar amigos o familiares.
Bonos por asistencia perfecta – Valoramos tu compromiso y confiabilidad.
Pago por días festivos – Pago de tiempo y medio en días festivos y horas extra.
Certificación gratuita en RCP – Te la proporcionamos sin costo.
Programas de reconocimiento – Premios mensuales, trimestrales y anuales por tu esfuerzo y dedicación.

¿Qué harás como Cuidador(a) de SYNERGY HomeCare?

Brindar atención no médica y personalizada a cada cliente.
Asistir en tareas diarias, como preparación de alimentos, limpieza ligera y recordatorios de medicamentos.
Ofrecer compañía y apoyo emocional para mejorar la calidad de vida de los clientes.
Construir relaciones de confianza con clientes, familias y compañeros de equipo.
Mantener un enfoque profesional y confiable en todo momento.

¿A quién buscamos?

Buscamos cuidadores(as) responsables, compasivos(as) y comprometidos(as) con mejorar la vida de los demás.

¿No tienes experiencia previa en cuidado? ¡No hay problema! Te ofrecemos capacitación completa y pagada para que desarrolles todas las habilidades necesarias y te sientas seguro(a) en tu trabajo.
¿Ya tienes experiencia en el cuidado de personas? Valoramos tu conocimiento y lo recompensamos como se merece. Además, ofrecemos oportunidades de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional, reconociendo tu esfuerzo y dedicación.

En SYNERGY HomeCare, creemos en apoyar a nuestros cuidadores para que puedan crecer tanto personal como profesionalmente, mientras brindan un servicio excepcional a nuestros clientes.

title: Registered Nurse (RN)
description:
Job Summary: Experience the SYNERGY HomeCare difference, where we are united under one purpose: to bring wholehearted, life-energizing care to as many people as possible - on their terms, in their own homes. And that starts with compassionate caregivers like YOU! When you join the SYNERGY HomeCare team as an RN, you will feel appreciated, recognized, and rewarded for the comforting, life-affirming care from your heart! Our promise to our clients is to bring full support for fuller lives and elevate their confidence, knowing they have an RN like you. 

Qualifications: 

A bachelor’s degree in a related field

Active  Registered Nurse (RN) license and BLS certification

Previous Clinical experience working within a Certified Home Health Agency (CHHA), Acute Care, Medical-Surgical, and Critical Care setting, Nursing Home background Solid assessment and documentation skills

Patient-oriented and great interpersonal skills

Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and Computer skills

Strong attention to detail

Highly organized

OFFERS: Competitive pay, Direct deposit, Paid orientation and ongoing training, Flexible schedules and matching caregivers with nearby clients

and Employee recognition programs.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS 

Assist with employee training as needed, utilizing your expertise as a registered nurse.

Evaluating the healthcare needs of patients and families with consideration regarding physiological, psychological, social, and environmental factors

Evaluating & Completing Home Safety Checklist

Implementing and revising the nursing care plan whenever necessary by regularly assessing, observing, and evaluating the patient's condition. 

Teaching the patient, family, and caregivers whenever appropriate and providing instruction regarding medication, diet, safety, and treatment modalities following the plan of care

Handling other duties as needed

Physical Demands 

The physical demands described here must be met by an associate while performing the duties of this job; the associate is frequently required to walk, sit, and talk or hear. The associate is occasionally required to use hands to finger, handle, feel, or operate objects, tools, or controls and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The associate must occasionally lift and move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

title: Marketing Representative
location: 551 S I-35 Frontage Rd, Round Rock, TX 78664, USA
description:
About Synergy HomeCare:
 
Synergy HomeCare is a leading provider of personalized in-home care services, including caregiving for seniors and professional babysitting services for families. Our mission is to promote dignity, independence, and peace of mind for every client we serve. We are expanding our outreach and looking for a dedicated Marketing Representative to build strong community relationships and generate referrals from hospitals, clinics, and care facilities.
 
Position Summary:
 
The Marketing Representative will be responsible for developing and managing relationships with healthcare professionals and referral sources to promote Synergy HomeCare’s services. This role involves field-based marketing, direct outreach to hospitals and medical facilities, and driving new client referrals for both caregiving and babysitting support.
 
 
Key Responsibilities:
• Conduct regular outreach visits to hospitals, rehabilitation centers, pediatric clinics, senior facilities, and physician offices.
• Build and maintain relationships with discharge planners, case managers, social workers, and other key referral sources.

• Promote Synergy HomeCare’s range of services, including in-home senior care and babysitting support for families.
• Represent the company at local networking events, health fairs, and community programs.
• Collaborate with the internal care team to ensure seamless onboarding of referred clients.
• Track outreach activities and maintain accurate records of contacts, leads, and referral outcomes.
• Provide ongoing market feedback and assist leadership with business development strategy.
 
 
Qualifications:
• Minimum 1–3 years of experience in healthcare marketing, sales, or business development (home care or senior services experience preferred).
• Familiarity with the local healthcare landscape and existing contacts within hospitals or care facilities is a strong advantage.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust-based relationships.
• Highly self-motivated and results-oriented.
• Valid driver’s license and access to reliable transportation for local travel.
 
 
Preferred Background:
• Experience working with hospitals, discharge planners, or pediatric care teams.
• Knowledge of home care industry regulations and referral processes.
• Ability to work independently and meet performance targets.

title: Passionate and Energetic Nanny with Special Needs Experience
description:
Are you a nurturing and dedicated Nanny that can drive, seeking a rewarding opportunity as a chilcare support?. A Family in Nothern New Jersey is looking for a Nanny that has 2 years experience or more in special needs or ABA. You are to take care of two energetic boys, the eldest boy needs special needs care.

 

Responsibilities:

1. Childcare Duties:

   - Engage and interact with the children in educational and recreational activities.

   - Always ensure the safety and well-being of the children.

   - Assist with personal care routines such as bathing, dressing, and grooming.

   - Help with homework and educational tasks as needed.

 

2. Household Management:

   - Manage children's laundry and maintain cleanliness in their living areas.

   - Prepare nutritious meals and snacks for the children.

   - Organize and maintain children's schedules, including school pickups and extracurricular activities.

   - Light housekeeping duties, including tidying common areas and loading/unloading the dishwasher.

3. Transportation:

   - Drive children to and from school, appointments, and activities as required.

   - Ensure children's safety during transportation and follow all traffic laws.

4. Bedtime Routine:

   - Assist with bedtime routines, including preparing children for bed and reading bedtime stories.

5. Communication:

   - Maintain open and clear communication with parents regarding children's activities, needs, and progress.

 

Shift Schedule: Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays and Saturdays (occasionally). After school. There might be additional during the summer holidays.

 

Requirements:

- Proven experience as a nanny or childcare provider, with a minimum of two years of relevant experience.

- RBT/Tech/ABA certifications for Special needs.

- Own car and valid driver's license with a clean driving record. Family care will be used for all family activities.

- The older boy has mild autism, and he currently has lessons after school 4-7pm everyday from Monday to Thursday.

- Experience working with children, in a school setting or as a live-in nanny and experience with special needs, including autism, is preferred but not required.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

- First Aid and CPR certification or willingness to take certifications. 

 

Benefits:

 * Competitive hourly rates

 * Generous bonuses may be available, depending on your work ability.

 

 

Interested applicants, please provide:

1. Desired bi-weekly salary expectation.

2. Potential start date.

 

Pre-Screening Questions: Do you have experience with special needs?.

Contact Information:

For inquiries or to apply, please contact us at 973-513-7222 or via email at cliftonjobs@synergyhomecare.com. Please reference 'Private Live-in Nanny Position' in your correspondence.

title: Caregiver
description:
Join SYNERGY HomeCare of Central IL – Where Caregivers Thrive & Feel at Home!

Do you have a big heart, a positive attitude, and a passion for helping others live their best lives? At SYNERGY HomeCare of Central IL, we don’t just hire caregivers—we celebrate them. ·       Supportive Culture – You’re never alone. From day one, we’ve got your back—with a real person on call 24/7 and a team that genuinely cares.

Medication reminders
Companionship and emotional support

Specialized care depending on client needs (training provided!)

title: Caregiver
description:
At SYNERGY HomeCare of Central IL, we believe laughter is the best medicine and compassion is the key to exceptional care. We are a team of fun-loving, caring professionals passionate about making a difference. If you have a heart of gold, a great sense of humor, and a love for helping others, we want you to join our crew as a Caregiver – aka Chief Happiness Officer!

Why Work With Us?

1. A Caring Community: At SYNERGY HomeCare of Central IL, you are not just an employee; you are part of our family. We foster a warm, supportive environment where everyone looks out for one another. Our team is a tight-knit community that celebrates each other's successes and supports each other through challenges.

2. Flexible Schedules: We understand that life can be unpredictable, and we believe in work-life balance. At SYNERGY HomeCare, you have the flexibility to create a schedule that fits your lifestyle. Whether you’re a student, a parent, or looking for extra hours, we work with you to find the perfect fit.

3. Competitive Pay: We value your hard work and dedication. Our pay rates are competitive, ranging from $15.50 to $19.50 per hour, depending on the level of care required. Plus, we offer paid time off, travel reimbursement, and an on-call program that pays $400 a weekend. We offer daily pay through TapCheck! 

4. Professional Growth: Your career development is important to us. We provide paid orientation and ongoing training to help you enhance your skills and knowledge. With our career growth opportunities, you can advance to roles such as Mentor, Office Assistant, Supervisor, or Manager. We believe in helping you reach your full potential.

5. Supportive Programs: We are committed to supporting you in every way possible. Our Employee Assistance Program is designed to help you overcome any roadblocks, whether you need an Uber when your car doesn’t start or assistance with other challenges. We are all about solutions and making your life easier.

6. Recognition and Rewards: We love to celebrate our caregivers! Through our Employee Recognition Program, we honor exceptional caregivers with awards like Caregiver of the Month, Excellence Award, and Caregiver of the Year. Additionally, our referral programs reward you for bringing new clients and caregivers to our team.

7. Meaningful Impact: Working at SYNERGY HomeCare means making a real difference in people's lives. You’ll have the opportunity to build deep, meaningful relationships with your clients, providing them with the care, companionship, and support they need. Your work will be rewarding, impactful, and truly appreciated.

8. Mentor Program: If you’re new to caregiving, don’t worry! We have experienced mentors ready to guide you. Our Caregiver Mentor Program ensures you have the support and training you need to succeed and feel confident in your role.

 

Responsibilities: 

Be the friendly face and warm heart that helps clients with daily activities such as bathing, dressing, grooming, and eating.
Spread cheer and companionship, turning every visit into a highlight of the day.
Assist with mobility and physical therapy exercises – think of it as your daily workout with friends. 
Perform light housekeeping duties and meal preparation (culinary skills not required, but brownie points if you can make brownies).


Monitor and report changes in clients’ health status – you’re basically their health guardian angel.
Keep detailed records of care provided because superheroes always keep track of their heroic deeds.
Communicate effectively with clients, families, and healthcare professionals – your jokes and stories are a bonus.

Qualifications:

 

A valid driver’s license, reliable vehicle (batmobile optional), and auto insurance are required.
Previous experience as a caregiver or in a related field preferred.
High school diploma or equivalent.
Ability to handle the physical demands of the job, including assisting with transferring clients – no super strength required, just super dedication.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills – a great sense of humor is a must!
Compassionate, patient, and reliable – basically, you’re a real-life superhero.

title: Weekend Senior Caregiver On Call
description:
We, all here at SYNERGY Home Care, are excited to have you as a Weekend Senior On Call Caregiver. You each are an asset in the care you provide and have the skills, maturity, drive, and reliability to be a part of the office “On Call” team.

This position fills open shifts when caregivers call out, or clients call over the weekend requesting extra hours.
What is Weekend On Call in the Field?

Each Weekend Senior On Call Caregiver rotates being On Call
Working shifts that come open at the last minute on the weekends (Friday from 5:30 pm Saturday, Sunday, and Monday to 7:30 am). Shifts become available when caregivers call out or a client has an unexpected need.
·       Each day (Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and Monday morning), you will be paid $100.00 for Friday and Saturday and $100.00 for Sunday and Monday for being available. If there is a call-out or client need and you work a shift, you will be paid for the shift and the $100.00.

 
How does it work?
When there is a call out, the Office will call and/or text the Weekend Senior Caregiver On Call to fill the open shift. 
Expectations

Respond to call/text within 30 minutes
Be at client’s within 1.5 hours of the initial call/text from the Office On Call person
Be able to support, male and female clients, smokers, households with pet, Hoyer lifts, clients on hospice, memory care clients and be willing to provide care throughout the Richmond area.
Agree to fill all open shifts, whether day time or overnight shifts.
Agree to be on a rotating schedule for On Call.

title: Professional Caregiver
description:
Professional Caregiver

SYNERGY HomeCare of Southeast Texas

Compensation

$11.00 - $15.00 per hour

Job Type : Both

Minimum Years of Experience

6 Months

Minimum Level of Education

High School

DESCRIPTION

SYNERGY HomeCare of Southeast Texas is seeking experienced caregivers with at least 6 months of personal or professional caregiving experience to provide in-home, non-medical care to clients in Southeast Texas. Whether your experience comes from caring for a family member or working in a professional setting, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about helping others and improving their quality of life.

Responsibilities:

Attend to clients' non-medical needs, providing general assistance and support.

Offer companionship, engaging clients in conversations, reading, and other social activities.

Help maintain clients' mental alertness (awareness and responsiveness) through activities tailored to their interests.

Provide emotional support, ensuring clients feel valued and comforted.

Maintain a clean, safe, and healthy environment in the client’s home.

Perform light housekeeping duties, such as laundry for clients' clothing and linens.

Prepare and serve meals, making sure the kitchen is clean afterward.

Accompany clients on walks, doctor’s appointments, and other outings.

Help clients with grooming and dressing, ensuring their personal care needs are met.

Remind clients to take self-administered medication (medications they take on their own, with reminders from you).

Observe and promptly report any changes in a client’s physical, mental, or emotional condition to your supervisor.

Build and maintain professional relationships with clients, their families, and co-workers.

Participate in ongoing training, staff meetings, and client discussions as needed.

Complete accurate documentation of the services you provide.

Safely use all equipment and supplies.

Protect the confidentiality of all client information.

Perform any additional related duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

6 months of personal or professional

Reliable transportation to and from work.

Strong communication skills and compassion for helping others.

Ability to work independently and in a team setting.

Reliable, patient, and detail-oriented.

Ability to pass a background check.

Benefits:

Competitive pay starting with opportunities to earn up to $15.00/hour based on experience and performance.

Medical, Vision and Dental Insurance

Paid Computer Based Training and Skills Lab Training

Employee Recognition and Incentive Programs

Flexible scheduling.

If you’re an experienced caregiver looking to make a positive impact, apply today!

SYNERGY HomeCare of Southeast Texas is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This role involves managing caregiver schedules, addressing last-minute changes, and maintaining compliance with company policies and industry regulations. The ideal candidate has excellent organizational, communication,and problem-solving skills. 


 

KEY REPONSIBILITIES:

1) Ensure that staffing levels meet the requirements of the patients’ care plans.

2) Develop and manage schedules for caregivers based on client needs and availability.

3) Ensure appropriate caregiver-to-client matching based on skills, experience, and client preferences.

4) Handle last-minute call-offs, replacements, and schedule adjustments promptly.

5) Act as the primary point of contact for caregivers and clients regarding scheduling matters.

6) Address client concerns related to staffing and escalate issues as needed.

7) Maintain regular communication with caregivers to confirm shifts and resolve any conflicts.

8) Maintain accurate records of schedules, attendance, and caregiver availability.

9) Monitor and report on staffing trends, shortages, and areas for improvement.

10) Answer all client questions or concerns, related to service, scheduling, billing, etc.

11) Update information and schedules as changes occur.

12) Document and properly follow-up with all client/employee incidents and complaints.

13) Assist with payroll processing by verifying hours worked and resolving discrepancies.

accurately process billing and payroll each week.






Monitor caseload metrics i.e gross margin, overtime, unfilled hours, etc.






manage billing and pay rates within approved limitless






Make decisions and provide feedback to employees related to recognition, pay rate changes, counseling and termination on employment. 




15) Follow up on all employee assignments immediately after services have begun, and on an ongoing basis, to ensure continuing satisfaction of clients, their families and employees.

16) Manage workers compensation claims and reporting. 

17) Together with the entire office staff, answer phone calls, greet visitors and generate correspondence as necessary for office needs. 


 

QUALIFICATION:




 Minimum (1) one year recent and verifiable within a Home Care setting






 Previous experience in healthcare staffing, scheduling or home care coordination preferred.






Have a sympathetic attitude toward the care of the sick and elderly.






Ambition to grow and advance beyond current position.






Maturity and ability to deal effectively with the demands of the job.






Must perform and manage multiple responsibilities concurrently and work well under pressure.






Excellent communication, strong organizational, problem-solving skills, and interpersonal skills.






Proficiency in scheduling software and Microsoft office (Word, Excel etc.)






Ability to deal with frequent interruptions, last minute changes to a previously-established schedule, multiple priorities and the ability to accomplish tasks against deadlines.






Perform responsibilities with minimal supervision, and must possess a high degree of initiative, and the ability to organize and prioritize responsibilities.

Join SYNERGY HomeCare – Where Caregivers Thrive!

At SYNERGY HomeCare of Central IL, we know that exceptional care starts with our caregivers. That’s why we prioritize your well-being, growth, and success. When you join our team, you’ll experience a workplace that truly values and supports you.

title: Babysitter New Haven
description:
Experience the SYNERGY HomeCare difference to bring life-energizing care to as many people as possible.  And that starts with compassionate, care-minded people like YOU! When you join the SYNERGY HomeCare team, you will feel appreciated, recognized, and rewarded for the comforting care that comes right from your heart! Our promise to our clients is to bring full support for fuller lives, knowing they can rely on high-quality childcare care from a caregiver like you.

Do you: 

Enjoy serving others?

Have a big heart with a lot of love to share with little ones? 

Take charge with a warm smile? 

We always have an opening for a babysitter who can answer yes to these questions. At SYNERGY HomeCare we create a world of care at home for all, which means as a babysitter, you will have the opportunity to care for a wide variety of children, spanning all ages and all abilities. We are seeking babysitters to join our independently owned and operated national agency to care for the littlest members of our community when their parents/guardians cannot be there.

SYNERGY HomeCare is currently accepting applications from responsible, outgoing individuals for flexible in-home childcare opportunities.  On-call childcare assignments may be last-minute, date nights, weekend coverage, or periodic care dates.  These are short-term placements and require individuals who enjoy working with a variety of families and children.

 

As an On-Call Babysitter with SYNERGY HomeCare, you will:

Ensure a healthy and safe environment

Provide attention to children’s needs, including engaging and fun activities

Care for infants, including feeding, diapering, and dressing

Prepare healthy snacks and meals

Encourage healthy habits and hygiene, and help with toilet training

Perform light housework, like laundry, dishes, and tidying up toys 

Help with homework as needed

Provide reliable care by being punctual and consistently covering shift

Preferred qualifications:

Experience as a babysitter, nanny, teacher, daycare worker, or camp counselor

Certification in first aid and child and infant CPR

Experience with special needs children

SYNERGY HomeCare offers:

Competitive pay 

Direct deposit

Paid orientation and ongoing training

Time-and-a-half pay for overtime and holidays

Flexible schedules and matching babysitters with nearby clients

Employee recognition programs

Benefits include:

Paid Sick Leave 

MyCTSavings 401K Account
